RE: Account reference: ACC-897135

Dear Ms. Cole,

Re: Dispute of Account ACC-897135

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account referenced above. You have disputed that the debt has already been paid. We understand that you have requested validation of the debt.

We have reviewed the account information and confirm that the current balance on the account is $6,176.50. The original creditor for this account is Horizon Card Co. As per the Florida Fair Debt Collection Practices Act, we are required to provide you with validation of the debt within 30 days of your request. We will provide you with the requested validation.

Regarding your concern about the address on your credit report, we understand that you have experienced issues with mail delivery. However, we must inform you that we do not have any record of a previous attempt to contact us by mail on the date you specified. We will make sure to update our records with your correct contact information.

We will investigate your dispute and provide you with a response within the next 30 days. If we determine that the debt has been paid, we will take the necessary steps to remove the account from our collection efforts.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe it is inaccurate or not owed. You may also request a copy of the validation we provide.

Sincerely,

National Credit Solutions
